Messages.Author: Tuomas Rinta
Messages.Body:
This is a deck I made a while ago, and would like some critisism and
advice on it, since I am going to play with it in a tournament in two
weeks.

Concept: Gangrels playing dominate and bleeding the hell out of my prey
with Earth Control used for stelth

Crypt (12 vamps): All of these are Gangrels, so I won't bother with the
clan
1 Stanislava (11, PRO, FOR, ANI, DOM, CEL, Inner Circle)
2 Ingrid Rossler (9, PRO, FOR, ANI, dom, Prince)
3 Iliana (7, FOR, PRO, DOM, tha)
2 Faruq (8, PRO, ANI, for, dom, pot)
2 Chandler Hungerford (3, PRO)
1 Ricki Van Demsi (3, pro, for)
1 Giulliano Vincenzi (2, for)

(Min: 11, Max: 37, Avg: 5.833)

Library: (90 cards)
Master: (18 cards)
1 Zoo Hunting Grounds
1 Backways
1 Elysium: the Arboretum
2 Archon Investigation
1 Freak Drive
1 Rötschrek
2 Sudden Reversal
2 Golgonda: Inner Peace
1 Elder Library
1 Information Highway
5 Dominate
1 KRCG News Radio
1 Rumor Mill, Tabloid Newspaper

Other: (4 cards)
4 Wake With Evening's Freshness
1 Elder Intervention

Animalism: (9 cards)
3 Drawing out the Beast
3 Cat's Guidance
3 Rat's Warning
Dominate: (18 cards)
3 Govern the Unaligned
3 Scouting Mission
5 Seduction
3 Conditioning
3 Threats
2 Bonding
Fortitude: (12 cards)
1 The Kiss of Ra
1 Dawn Operation
4 Skin of Rock
5 Skin of Steel
2 Indominability
2 Unflinching Persistance
Protean: (24 cards)
1 Flesh of Marble
3 Form of Mist
4 Earth Control
3 Claws of the Dead
3 Wolf Claws
3 Gleam of Red Eyes
3 Form of Ghost
4 Earth Meld

The point is to bleed a _lot_ with stealth, and if someone decides to
intercept, send them to torpor or play Form of Mist...
Opinions?

Tuomas Rinta

Messages.Author: davey! sprocket
Messages.Body:
On Wed, 4 Aug 1999, Tuomas Rinta wrote:

> Crypt (12 vamps): All of these are Gangrels, so I won't bother with
> the clan

What!? No Caitlin? Could also play: Dylan, Lizette...

> The point is to bleed a _lot_ with stealth, and if someone decides to
> intercept, send them to torpor or play Form of Mist... Opinions?

I find that playing the Form of Mist first, then the stealth or perhaps an
Earth Meld works much better than the other way around, as it winds up
leaving more of your prey's minions tapped and more of yours untapped. I
would try to focus more on PRO w/ FoM and less on DOM. You can use
Computer Hacking to go a long way, and prolly cut a few Dominate Masters
or some of the older vamps...

-davey!

Avg vampire size = 6.42
I generally play this with some more princes and (ab)use MT-5th while
freak driving a whole lot more and bleeding with dominate less.

others have already commented on Sadie, Caitlin, etc.

> Library: (90 cards)
I get 92 total cards
> Master: (18 cards)
I get 20 total 'master' cards. 19 if you move Freak drive down to a
fortitude card

> 1 Zoo Hunting Grounds
> 1 Backways
> 1 Elysium: the Arboretum

> 2 Archon Investigation
> 1 Freak Drive

Probably want to move this to fortitude

> 1 Rötschrek
> 2 Sudden Reversal
> 2 Golgonda: Inner Peace

Maybe drop down to one of these since they are not something that you
will usually need more than one of.
> 1 Elder Library
I prefer fraggy if you plan on intercepting, or the barrens since you
can move more cards that way.

> 1 Information Highway
> 5 Dominate

gee that's a lot of skill cards.

> 1 KRCG News Radio
> 1 Rumor Mill, Tabloid Newspaper

and a lot of pool spent on intercept for a deck that intends to bleed
alot.

> Other: (4 cards)
I get 5 cards in this catagory

> 4 Wake With Evening's Freshness
> 1 Elder Intervention

The +2 intercept is nice, but again, is this a bleed deck or an
intercept deck?

> Animalism: (9 cards)
> 3 Drawing out the Beast
> 3 Cat's Guidance
> 3 Rat's Warning

all excellent choices
> Dominate: (18 cards)
I get 19 cards in this catagory

> 3 Govern the Unaligned
> 3 Scouting Mission
> 5 Seduction

You have the capacity to use these, but they will tend to jam unless
you use them at all oppourtunities. Perhaps more Form of mists would
be more useful to your vampires since they have more of that skill.

> 3 Conditioning
> 3 Threats
> 2 Bonding

That's more than I would normally play with, but you will be putting
your prey in a hurt locker if he doesn't have bounce. That is the real
problem that I see with this, you do bleed for a lot, but bounce will
kill you (or rather oust your grand prey). I prefer more bleeds at
less for each bleed thereby reducing the problems that bounce introduce.

> Fortitude: (12 cards)
I get 15 cards in this catagory (and 16 if you count the Freak Drive)

> 1 The Kiss of Ra

A definate in this deck - perhaps 2 would be better

> 1 Dawn Operation
> 4 Skin of Rock
> 5 Skin of Steel
> 2 Indominability
> 2 Unflinching Persistance

Lots of prevent. Perhaps Earth Control and Form of mist can be
depended on more heavily to get the bleeds through.

> Protean: (24 cards)
> 1 Flesh of Marble
> 3 Form of Mist
> 4 Earth Control

> 3 Claws of the Dead
> 3 Wolf Claws

poke and munch!

> 3 Gleam of Red Eyes
> 3 Form of Ghost

Lots of manuvers for a deck that should have S:CE when a poke in the
eye with a sharp claw won't get the job done.
> 4 Earth Meld

Anyway. a good deck - need to work on the math skills perhaps, but a
good solid all around deck.

I can get you a copy of my Illiana/Ingrid deck if you would like.
Cheerios
Stu

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
ne...@doughty-engineering.co.uk wrote:
> > [75 lines of non-pertinent quoted text deleted]

> OK, I like your deck and was recently chatting to James Coup and found
> out about the D out the B and Form of mist .....well this lead to a
> new deck idea after the Portsmouth Tourney and the first game was an
> absolute dream.....

> [snip]

> I managed to torporize 3 vampires with one bum's rush with the old
> dawn op, drawing out the beast, form of mist combo.

That would be difficult, since Dawn Op only "works" for combats
resulting from blocks, and you can only play superior Form of
Mist once per action (since it counts as an action modifier when
used by an acting vampire). So, if you were blocked a second time
(after ending the first combat with FoM), the damage would be agg
but you would only be able to dodge with FoM - you couldn't
continue on to a third combat. (And if the Rush isn't blocked, the
damage won't be agg.)

Good concept. I have had one of these decks for a long time. It's quite
effective. I have won a couple of tournaments with it.

>Crypt (12 vamps): All of these are Gangrels, so I won't bother with the
>clan

>2 Ingrid Rossler (9, PRO, FOR, ANI, dom, Prince)

>1 Giulliano Vincenzi (2, for)

smaller vamps.

I would loose the Golconda's and Elder library. They probably won't be very
useful in this deck. You also need to decide on whether your going to
intercept or not. If so you can keep the KRCG and tabloid paper but you
should add more cats. It probably best to lose them if you are not going to
commit more to intercept.

>Other: (4 cards)
>4 Wake With Evening's Freshness
>1 Elder Intervention
>
>Animalism: (9 cards)
>3 Drawing out the Beast
>3 Cat's Guidance
>3 Rat's Warning

If you want to incerpt loose the onther animalism cards and put in more
cats. If not loose them all and commit the space to stealth or wakes.

>Dominate: (18 cards)
>3 Govern the Unaligned
>3 Scouting Mission
>5 Seduction
>3 Conditioning
>3 Threats
>2 Bonding

In my experience more stealth, bleed, or bounce is far better than
Seduction. I would add some more bleed cards or even better deflections. You
are using dominate after all...

>Fortitude: (12 cards)
>1 The Kiss of Ra
>1 Dawn Operation
>4 Skin of Rock
>5 Skin of Steel
>2 Indominability
>2 Unflinching Persistance
>Protean: (24 cards)
>1 Flesh of Marble
>3 Form of Mist
>4 Earth Control
>3 Claws of the Dead
>3 Wolf Claws
>3 Gleam of Red Eyes
>3 Form of Ghost
>4 Earth Meld

I would cut down the combat. Less fortitude. You can use Form of the Mist or
Rapid Change to end combat. Keep some Skin of Steel to deal with Immortal
grapple and Thoughts betrayed. Forget the Dawn Op unless you put in enough
to use that type of strategy. Loose the Wolf claws and replace them with
Claws of the Dead. This allows for manuevers so you can replace most of the
protean manuever cards. You need Rapid Change (for more stealth and end
combat), more Form of the Mist and more earth control if you hope to
successfully stealth bleed. I have about 7 of each in my deck but my game
environment has lots of intercept.

>The point is to bleed a _lot_ with stealth, and if someone decides to
>intercept, send them to torpor or play Form of Mist...
>Opinions?

You need much more stealth. Combat is good, but for this type of deck to be
successful you will have to concentrate on bleed and stealth. Keep a few
claws and other combat to surprise blockers but you should try not to be
blocked. If you end up with lots of combat in the game you can also use the
Form of the Mist and Rapid Change to end combat if you need.

Steve Bucy

>Tuomas Rinta
